<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# H7 confirmed: Player moves 2 cells through WALL tiles only.
# Player at (5,8). Try UP to test if D (dark) counts as wall.
# Path to green at (7,4) needs wall route.

result = action(['UP'], intent='explore')
print(f"UP: board_changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
player_pos = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b':
        br, bc = n['boundary'][0]
        gr = (br - 21) // 3
        gc = (bc - 12) // 3
        player_pos = (gr, gc)
        break
print(f"Player at: {player_pos}")

# Rebuild grid
grid = {}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] <= 9:
        br, bc = n['boundary'][0]
        gr = (br - 21) // 3
        gc = (bc - 12) // 3
        symbol = n['color']
        if n['color'] == 'b':
            symbol = 'P'
        elif n['color'] == 'N':
            symbol = 'G'
        elif n['color'] in ('W', 'g'):
            symbol = '#'
        elif n['color'] == 'B':
            symbol = 'D'
        elif n['color'] == 'p':
            symbol = 'p'
        elif n['color'] == 'c':
            symbol = 'c'
        grid[(gr, gc)] = symbol

for gr in range(-1, 8):
    row = ''
    for gc in range(13):
        row += grid.get((gr, gc), '.')
    print(f"Row {gr}: {row}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
